english.title: Unauthorised non-UK registered aircraft take on board / discharge passengers / cargo in UK for valuable consideration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[charterer]_
(C)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), registered elsewhere than the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY WHERE REGISTERED..), which, without permission granted in accordance with article 250(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016, and where article 250(6) of the Order did not apply,

(D)_[took on board passengers]_
(E)_[discharged passengers]_
(F)_[took on board cargo]_
(G)_[discharged cargo]_

in the United Kingdom where valuable consideration was

(H)_[given]_
(I)_[promised]_

for the carriage of such

(J)_[persons]_
(K)_[cargo]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 250(1) and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
were the operator, charterer or pilot in command of an aircraft registered elsewhere than the United Kingdom, which,
without permission granted in accordance with article 250(2) of the Order, and where article 250(6) of the Order did not apply,
took on board or discharged passengers or cargo in the United Kingdom
where valuable consideration was given or promised for the carriage of such persons or cargo

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
